# App memory mirror (auto-generated)

This file mirrors the user's Claude app memory. It is overwritten by a scheduled sync, so don't edit it by hand: put your own notes in CLAUDE.md instead. Treat it as background context, not as tasks.

Last synced: YYYY-MM-DD

## Who I am

- Name, what they go by, and what they are working toward.
- Background, skills and experience that matter when helping them build things.

## How to talk to me

- Language, tone and formatting rules from their preferences.

## Projects

- One line per ongoing project: what it is, current status, key decisions (stack, names, direction).
- A project they code on a lot may get a few indented sub-lines.

## Sending notes back to the Claude app

This section is an instruction, not background. When the user tells you something durable about themselves, their preferences, or a project decision (a new project, a changed plan, a chosen name, stack or direction), append one line to <FOLDER>/from-code.md in the format `- YYYY-MM-DD [project] what they said or decided`, in their own terms. Skip code-level details (file names, bugs, function names), anything you inferred rather than heard from them, secrets or keys, and personal or sensitive details. Never edit or delete existing lines there.

## Machines

- Computers and tools they work on, if memory has them.
